guard.limitation: Evidence readiness is not a human release authorization. Neither screenshot pixels nor reviewer assertions prove all behavior.

missing: source changed since approved baseline; reconcile independent source review
complete, current semantic review and per-requirement test evidence required
actual bounded implementation run and recorded source change required
stale.limitation: Evidence readiness is not a human release authorization. Neither screenshot pixels nor reviewer assertions prove all behavior.

restored.limitation: Evidence readiness is not a human release authorization. Neither screenshot pixels nor reviewer assertions prove all behavior.

evidence: Independent parent-session review: source, immutable tests/spec, Git diff and initial failing tests inspected; REQ-ADD passed.
